related.description: Complete implementation of JWx (Javascript Object Signing and Encryption/JOSE) technologies for Go. #golang #jwt #jws #jwk #jwe
Java JWT: JSON Web Token for Java and Android
JSON Web Token implementation for Java according to RFC 7519. Easily create, parse and validate JSON Web Tokens using a fluent API.
Jose-Simple allows the encryption and decryption of data using the JOSE (JSON Object Signing and Encryption) standard.
Safe, simple and fast JSON Web Tokens for Go
